how_made: Language, class and kind were fixed for every slot by a seeded shuffle before writing. The author read one excerpt per document and wrote each pair by hand to its slot; no pair was generated by a script or a template. Pair ids were assigned by a seeded shuffle so that order carries no label. The rule is authoring-spec.md. One pair whose statements came close to a training-set statement was rewritten on a different fact of the same document before the set was assembled. Statement length was not balanced in this set.

review.planned: blind relabel by a model from another vendor, labels committed before the reference labels are opened; pairs with any disagreement are left out of use and no label is changed
